description: Matched-pair OR (unbelted vs belted, two-occupant vehicles with one death) under two-sided misreporting (f survivors, g deaths) with closed-form tipping fractions
population: FARS 2016-2024 occupants (driver/passenger) of in-transport light passenger vehicles, seat front-left/front-other/second row, age 13+, belted or unbelted, known outcome; vehicles with exactly 2 eligible occupants and exactly one death
method: Expected discordant counts n10(1-f)(1-g) and n01 + f n00 + g n11 + f g n10; Poisson CI treating vehicles as independent
